name: zinterp_context_push_file_frame
description: zInterp_Context::PushFileFrame grows the script file-frame stack, stores the file pointer, file position, and prepared-input flag, increments the frame count, and returns success.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c18c0 validates the realloc size as (fileFrameCount + 1) * 0x0c, fileFrameStack store at context offset 0x9c, fileFrameCount at offset 0xa0, frame field stores at offsets 0, 4, and 8, count increment, and constant success return.
The native smoke verifies single and repeated pushes preserve frame order and store file pointer, file position, prepared-input flag, and frame count.
